lesson: The system is consistently failing to distinguish between genuine structural shifts and localized liquidity sweeps, leading to premature entries against the dominant 4h/daily bearish trend. By prioritizing low-timeframe SMC signals over the macro distribution phase, the strategy is repeatedly catching falling knives.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend Alignment Filter' that mandates a 4h market structure break in the direction of the trade before allowing any 15m/1h entry signals.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less when the 4h/daily timeframe shows clear distribution.
